annotations.title: Lists picked by a stated rule

description: Use this when a family asks for lists of NYC schools or neighborhoods picked by a rule rather than a ranking: zoned schools that beat their district while serving high-need students; high school programs with more seats per applicant; schools where no group is a majority and families rate them highly (kind 'schools'); or affordable family neighborhoods with such a school, and family neighborhoods where no single group is a majority (kind 'neighborhoods'). Optionally one borough. Each list carries its rule, its true count and its first members. State the rule; don't call members 'best' or 'hidden gems'.

borough.description: Only when the family named a borough; omit it for citywide.

kind.description: 'neighborhoods' for the neighborhood lists (affordable family neighborhoods with a school that beats its district; family neighborhoods where no single group is a majority); 'schools' for the school lists (zoned schools that beat their district while serving high-need students; high school programs with more seats per applicant; schools where no group is a majority and families rate them highly).

name: find-collections
